genes.name: Hemoglobin subunit alpha 1
genes.definition: Homo sapiens hemoglobin subunit alpha 1 (HBA1), mRNA.
genes.functionSummary: The human alpha globin gene cluster located on chromosome 16 spans about 30 kb and includes seven loci: 5'- zeta - pseudozeta - mu - pseudoalpha-1 - alpha-2 - alpha-1 - theta - 3'.
genes.functionSummaryCredit: RefSeq, Jul 2008 (first sentence of the RefSeq summary in NM_000558.5)

genes.name: Hemoglobin subunit delta
genes.definition: Homo sapiens hemoglobin subunit delta (HBD), mRNA.
genes.functionSummary: The delta (HBD) and beta (HBB) genes are normally expressed in the adult: two alpha chains plus two beta chains constitute HbA, which in normal adult life comprises about 97% of the total hemoglobin.
genes.functionSummaryCredit: RefSeq, Jul 2008 (first sentence of the RefSeq summary in NM_000519.4)

genes.name: Myoglobin
genes.definition: Homo sapiens myoglobin (MB), transcript variant 1, mRNA.
genes.functionSummary: This gene encodes a member of the globin superfamily and is predominantly expressed in skeletal and cardiac muscles.
genes.functionSummaryCredit: RefSeq, May 2020 (first sentence of the RefSeq summary in NM_005368.3)

genes.name: Glucagon
genes.definition: Homo sapiens glucagon (GCG), mRNA.
genes.functionSummary: The protein encoded by this gene is a proglucagon precursor that is cleaved into four distinct mature peptides.
genes.functionSummaryCredit: RefSeq, Mar 2026 (first sentence of the RefSeq summary in NM_002054.5)

genes.name: Leptin
genes.definition: Homo sapiens leptin (LEP), mRNA.
genes.functionSummary: This gene encodes a protein that is secreted by white adipocytes into the circulation and plays a major role in the regulation of energy homeostasis.
genes.functionSummaryCredit: RefSeq, Aug 2017 (first sentence of the RefSeq summary in NM_000230.3)

genes.name: Parathyroid hormone
genes.definition: Homo sapiens parathyroid hormone (PTH), transcript variant 1, mRNA.
genes.functionSummary: This gene encodes a member of the parathyroid family of proteins.
genes.functionSummaryCredit: RefSeq, Oct 2015 (first sentence of the RefSeq summary in NM_000315.4)

genes.name: Neuropeptide Y
genes.definition: Homo sapiens neuropeptide Y (NPY), mRNA.
genes.functionSummary: This gene encodes a neuropeptide that is widely expressed in the central nervous system and influences many physiological processes, including cortical excitability, stress response, food intake, circadian rhythms, and cardiovascular function.
genes.functionSummaryCredit: RefSeq, Oct 2014 (first sentence of the RefSeq summary in NM_000905.4)

genes.name: Transthyretin
genes.definition: Homo sapiens transthyretin (TTR), mRNA.
genes.functionSummary: This gene encodes one of the three prealbumins, which include alpha-1-antitrypsin, transthyretin and orosomucoid.
genes.functionSummaryCredit: RefSeq, Aug 2017 (first sentence of the RefSeq summary in NM_000371.4)

genes.name: Beta-2-microglobulin
genes.definition: Homo sapiens beta-2-microglobulin (B2M), mRNA.
genes.functionSummary: This gene encodes a serum protein found in association with the major histocompatibility complex (MHC) class I heavy chain on the surface of nearly all nucleated cells.
genes.functionSummaryCredit: RefSeq, Aug 2014 (first sentence of the RefSeq summary in NM_004048.4)

genes.name: Rhodopsin
genes.definition: Homo sapiens rhodopsin (RHO), mRNA.
genes.functionSummary: The protein encoded by this gene is found in rod cells in the back of the eye and is essential for vision in low-light conditions.
genes.functionSummaryCredit: RefSeq, Aug 2017 (first sentence of the RefSeq summary in NM_000539.3)

genes.name: Glutathione peroxidase 1
genes.definition: Homo sapiens glutathione peroxidase 1 (GPX1), transcript variant 1, mRNA.
genes.functionSummary: The protein encoded by this gene belongs to the glutathione peroxidase family, members of which catalyze the reduction of organic hydroperoxides and hydrogen peroxide (H2O2) by glutathione, and thereby protect cells against oxidative damage.
genes.functionSummaryCredit: RefSeq, Aug 2017 (first sentence of the RefSeq summary in NM_000581.4)

genes.name: DNA ligase 1
genes.definition: Homo sapiens DNA ligase 1 (LIG1), transcript variant 1, mRNA.
genes.functionSummary: This gene encodes a member of the ATP-dependent DNA ligase protein family.
genes.functionSummaryCredit: RefSeq, Jan 2014 (first sentence of the RefSeq summary in NM_000234.3)

genes.name: Melanocortin 1 receptor
genes.definition: Homo sapiens melanocortin 1 receptor (MC1R), mRNA.
genes.functionSummary: This intronless gene encodes the receptor protein for melanocyte-stimulating hormone (MSH).
genes.functionSummaryCredit: RefSeq, Jul 2008 (first sentence of the RefSeq summary in NM_002386.4)

genes.name: Taste 2 receptor member 38
genes.definition: Homo sapiens taste 2 receptor member 38 (TAS2R38), mRNA.
genes.functionSummary: This gene encodes a seven-transmembrane G protein-coupled receptor that controls the ability to taste glucosinolates, a family of bitter-tasting compounds found in plants of the Brassica sp.
genes.functionSummaryCredit: RefSeq, Oct 2009 (first sentence of the RefSeq summary in NM_176817.5)

genes.name: Opsin 1, long wave sensitive
genes.definition: Homo sapiens opsin 1, long wave sensitive (OPN1LW), mRNA.
genes.functionSummary: This gene encodes for a light absorbing visual pigment of the opsin gene family.
genes.functionSummaryCredit: RefSeq, Jul 2008 (first sentence of the RefSeq summary in NM_020061.6)

genes.name: Apolipoprotein E
genes.definition: Homo sapiens apolipoprotein E (APOE), transcript variant 2, mRNA.
genes.functionSummary: The protein encoded by this gene is a major apoprotein of the chylomicron.
genes.functionSummaryCredit: RefSeq, Jun 2016 (first sentence of the RefSeq summary in NM_000041.4)

genes.name: KRas proto-oncogene, GTPase
genes.definition: Homo sapiens KRas proto-oncogene, GTPase (KRAS), transcript variant b, mRNA.
genes.functionSummary: This gene, a Kirsten ras oncogene homolog from the mammalian ras gene family, encodes a protein that is a member of the small GTPase superfamily.
genes.functionSummaryCredit: RefSeq, Jul 2008 (first sentence of the RefSeq summary in NM_004985.5)

genes.name: Erythropoietin
genes.definition: Homo sapiens erythropoietin (EPO), mRNA.
genes.functionSummary: This gene encodes a secreted, glycosylated cytokine composed of four alpha helical bundles.
genes.functionSummaryCredit: RefSeq, Aug 2017 (first sentence of the RefSeq summary in NM_000799.4)

genes.name: Growth hormone 1
genes.definition: Homo sapiens growth hormone 1 (GH1), transcript variant 1, mRNA.
genes.functionSummary: The protein encoded by this gene is a member of the somatotropin/prolactin family of hormones which play an important role in growth control.
genes.functionSummaryCredit: RefSeq, Jul 2008 (first sentence of the RefSeq summary in NM_000515.5)

genes.name: Sex determining region Y
genes.definition: Homo sapiens sex determining region Y (SRY), mRNA.
genes.functionSummary: This intronless gene encodes a transcription factor that is a member of the high mobility group (HMG)-box family of DNA-binding proteins.
genes.functionSummaryCredit: RefSeq, Jul 2008 (first sentence of the RefSeq summary in NM_003140.3)

genes.name: Brain derived neurotrophic factor
genes.definition: Homo sapiens brain derived neurotrophic factor (BDNF), transcript variant 4, mRNA.
genes.functionSummary: This gene encodes a member of the nerve growth factor family of proteins.
genes.functionSummaryCredit: RefSeq, Nov 2015 (first sentence of the RefSeq summary in NM_001709.5)

genes.name: Tumor protein p53
genes.definition: Homo sapiens tumor protein p53 (TP53), transcript variant 1, mRNA.
genes.functionSummary: This gene encodes a tumor suppressor protein containing transcriptional activation, DNA binding, and oligomerization domains.
genes.functionSummaryCredit: RefSeq, Dec 2016 (first sentence of the RefSeq summary in NM_000546.6)

genes.name: Actinin alpha 3
genes.definition: Homo sapiens actinin alpha 3 (ACTN3), transcript variant 1, coding, mRNA.
genes.functionSummary: This gene encodes a member of the alpha-actin binding protein gene family.
genes.functionSummaryCredit: RefSeq, Apr 2024 (first sentence of the RefSeq summary in NM_001104.4)

genes.name: BRCA1 DNA repair associated
genes.definition: Homo sapiens BRCA1 DNA repair associated (BRCA1), transcript variant 1, mRNA.
genes.functionSummary: This gene encodes a 190 kD nuclear phosphoprotein that plays a role in maintaining genomic stability, and it also acts as a tumor suppressor.
genes.functionSummaryCredit: RefSeq, May 2020 (first sentence of the RefSeq summary in NM_007294.4)

genes.name: BRCA2 DNA repair associated
genes.definition: Homo sapiens BRCA2 DNA repair associated (BRCA2), transcript variant 1, mRNA.
genes.functionSummary: The product of this gene in involved in maintenance of genome stability.
genes.functionSummaryCredit: RefSeq, May 2026 (first sentence of the RefSeq summary in NM_000059.4)

genes.name: CF transmembrane conductance regulator
genes.definition: Homo sapiens CF transmembrane conductance regulator (CFTR), mRNA.
genes.functionSummary: This gene encodes a member of the ATP-binding cassette (ABC) transporter superfamily.
genes.functionSummaryCredit: RefSeq, Aug 2017 (first sentence of the RefSeq summary in NM_000492.4)

genes.name: Forkhead box P2
genes.definition: Homo sapiens forkhead box P2 (FOXP2), transcript variant 1, mRNA.
genes.functionSummary: This gene encodes a member of the forkhead/winged-helix (FOX) family of transcription factors.
genes.functionSummaryCredit: RefSeq, Feb 2010 (first sentence of the RefSeq summary in NM_014491.4)

genes.name: Huntingtin
genes.definition: Homo sapiens huntingtin (HTT), transcript variant 1, mRNA.
genes.functionSummary: Huntingtin is a disease gene linked to Huntington's disease, a neurodegenerative disorder characterized by loss of striatal neurons.
genes.functionSummaryCredit: RefSeq, Jul 2016 (first sentence of the RefSeq summary in NM_001388492.1)

genes.name: Dystrophin
genes.definition: Homo sapiens dystrophin (DMD), transcript variant Dp427m, mRNA.
genes.functionSummary: This gene spans a genomic range of greater than 2 Mb and encodes a large protein containing an N-terminal actin-binding domain and multiple spectrin repeats.
genes.functionSummaryCredit: RefSeq, Dec 2016 (first sentence of the RefSeq summary in NM_004006.3)
